title: Assembly Lead
description:
TITLE: Assembly Lead
TYPE: Direct Hire
LOCATION: Fairless Hills, PA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Onsite
START DATE: November 2025
SHIFT: 1 st Shift


We are seeking a hands-on, technically skilled leader to oversee day-to-day activities within the Assembly Shop. This role is responsible for providing direction, technical expertise, and support to ensure efficient operations, product quality, and on-time delivery.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Provide guidance and troubleshooting support to resolve technical or process-related challenges on the shop floor.
  • Work closely with the General Assembly Manager to set priorities and manage workloads to meet customer shipment commitments.
  • Allocate assignments according to team members' skills and verify that standard assembly procedures are consistently applied.
  • Monitor and update work orders and employee labor entries to ensure accurate and timely documentation.
  • Foster a collaborative, professional, and safety-conscious work environment through positive leadership and example.
  • When needed, assist in the assembly of standard and custom-built cabinets.
  • Inspect finished assemblies and equipment to confirm quality standards are met prior to shipment.
  • Contribute to performance evaluations by offering feedback and recommendations for employee development.
  • Maintain compliance with company policies, safety protocols, and housekeeping standards.
  • Perform additional related duties as directed by management.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • 2–3 years of experience in a technical lead or supervisory capacity within an electro-mechanical assembly environment.
  • Proven ability to identify issues, prioritize tasks, and motivate team members toward successful outcomes.
  • Basic electrical knowledge and the ability to interpret blueprints and wiring schematics.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and proficiency with a variety of hand tools.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Physical Requirements
  • Must be capable of lifting up to 50 pounds.
  • Able to stand and perform physical tasks for prolonged periods.

EOE STATEMENT

title: WMS Solution Architect
description:
TITLE: Warehouse Management System (WMS) Solution Architect
TYPE: Direct Hire
LOCATION: Souderton, PA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Hybrid, onsite 3 days a week, with up to 25% overnight travel
START DATE: October/November 2025


We are looking for an accomplished, self-driven WMS Solution Architect to design, integrate, and deliver advanced warehouse management and automation solutions across a large-scale North American distribution network. This position plays a key role within the Enterprise Applications team, supporting a complex aftermarket parts operation with more than half a million SKUs, 15 distribution centers, and a combination of company-owned and 3PL-managed facilities — several of which exceed one million square feet.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Partner with business, operations, and technology stakeholders to assess requirements and design WMS and automation solutions optimized for high-volume, multi-SKU environments.
  • Lead full lifecycle implementation efforts — including requirements definition, solution architecture, vendor evaluation, configuration, testing, and go-live execution.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance across IT, operations, and partner teams.
  • Architect scalable, integrated systems that connect WMS platforms with SAP ECC WM/EWM and warehouse automation technologies.
  • Remain up to date with evolving technologies and trends in warehouse automation, robotics, and digital supply chain solutions.
  • Oversee integration with third-party logistics providers to ensure smooth data synchronization and alignment of warehouse processes.
  • Establish and maintain architectural frameworks, documentation, and best practices for warehouse and automation systems.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related discipline (Master's preferred).
  • Minimum of 7 years of hands-on experience in WMS architecture and implementation.
  • SAP certification in WM or EWM preferred.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based WMS solutions and IoT-connected systems.
  • Skilled at converting business needs into efficient, scalable technical designs.
  • Proven track record implementing automation technologies such as VLMs, AMRs, pick-to-light systems, and conveyors.
  • Understanding of Agile or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
  • Advanced proficiency in at least one top-tier WMS platform (Manhattan, Blue Yonder, or SAP EWM).
  • Strong background in SAP ECC WM and/or SAP EWM integration.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating with 3PL systems and managing hybrid warehouse environments.
  • Background in automotive aftermarket, parts distribution, or similar industries is highly desirable.
  • Experience in large-scale, high-SKU distribution operations.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving abilities.

EOE STATEMENT

title: Markets Automation and Quality Assurance Contractor
description:
TITLE:  Market Automation and QA Contractor
TYPE:  Contract
LOCATION:  Norristown, PA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID:  Hybrid, onsite 2 times a week
START DATE:  October/November 2025
SHIFT:  Monday – Friday, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm


We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented, Market Automation and Quality Assurance Contractor to support the development and enhancement of tools and processes within Market Operations. In this role, you will identify manual workflows that can be automated, design and build efficient technical solutions, and ensure operational tools remain compliant with business and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong programming skills with the ability to collaborate across teams to deliver reliable, high-quality automation solutions.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Update and enhance existing market tools to reflect changing business requirements and regulatory obligations, maintaining accurate and up-to-date documentation.
  • Provide troubleshooting and technical support for automation tools and related applications.
  • Analyze and evaluate current operational processes to identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvement.
  • Partner with IT teams and other internal stakeholders to design and deliver integrated, sustainable automation solutions.
  • Design, develop, and implement automation tools and systems to support Market Operations activities.
  • Research and assess emerging technologies for potential application in market automation and process optimization.
  • Support the hardware and software needs of Market Operations and Market Design functions as new systems and improvements are deployed.
 
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2–3 years of professional experience in software development, automation design, or systems support.
  • Proficiency in .NET, C#, PL/SQL, and Windows Presentation Framework (WPF).
  • Prior experience in energy market operations or a related technical environment is preferred.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to learn and adapt quickly.
  • Strong grasp of object-oriented programming principles.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of formal change control and quality assurance processes.
  • Experience with REST APIs, Python, SAS, VBA, and asynchronous programming.
  • Familiarity with GitLab, Tableau, Windows Services, and SQL tuning.
  • Exposure to data science, machine learning, or artificial intelligence concepts.

title: Industrial Painter
description:
TITLE: Industrial Painter
TYPE: Direct Hire
LOCATION: Fishers, IN
SHIFT: M-F 6am - 2:30pm
START DATE: October/November 2025

We are seeking a skilled Industrial Painter to apply enamel coatings to fabricated metal parts using an HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure) spray system. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with industrial painting processes and a strong commitment to quality and safety.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Maintain paint spray guns and related equipment to ensure consistent performance.
  • Thorough knowledge of HVLP spray equipment—setup, adjustment, cleaning, and routine maintenance.
  • Familiarity with industrial safety procedures and proper handling of paints, solvents, and hazardous materials.
  • Proven experience working with enamel paint systems, including surface prep, masking, mixing, and application methods.
  • Keen eye for detail and consistency in achieving high-quality finishes.
  • Prepare all metal surfaces to ensure they are clean, properly finished, and ready for paint application.
  • Keep the paint area organized, clean, and compliant with safety standards.
  • Ability to safely operate forklifts and pallet jacks in a production setting.
  • Use material-handling tools and equipment as needed to move components through the painting process.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 2–5 years of experience applying industrial coatings or finishes in a manufacturing or fabrication environment.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently or as part of a collaborative team.
  • Effective communication skills for working with supervisors and production teams.
  • Background in maintaining and troubleshooting spray systems and identifying performance issues early.
  • Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs and managing materials safely and efficiently.
  • Must be able to bend, kneel, climb, and work in physically demanding positions for extended periods.
  • Able to wear respirators and other required PPE throughout the shift.
